description: Defines the PlatformVideoFramePool class, a GPU video frame pool for ChromeOS, managing VideoFrame objects to optimize memory allocation and reuse. Includes methods for initialization, frame retrieval, and management, with thread safety considerations.

classes.name: PlatformVideoFramePool
classes.description: A GPU memory buffer pool for managing VideoFrame objects efficiently on ChromeOS, supporting buffer initialization, frame retrieval, and thread-safe management.

methods.name: PlatformVideoFramePool
methods.description: Constructor for the video frame pool.

methods.name: GetGpuMemoryBufferId
methods.description: Static method to retrieve the GPU memory buffer ID from a VideoFrame.

methods.name: AsPlatformVideoFramePool
methods.description: Returns a pointer to this object, cast as PlatformVideoFramePool.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the pool with specified format, size, and buffer options.

methods.name: GetFrame
methods.description: Retrieves a VideoFrame from the pool.

methods.name: IsExhausted
methods.description: Checks if the pool has no available frames.

methods.name: NotifyWhenFrameAvailable
methods.description: Sets a callback to notify when a frame becomes available.

methods.name: ReleaseAllFrames
methods.description: Releases all frames in the pool.

methods.name: GetGpuBufferLayout
methods.description: Returns the GPU buffer layout if available.

methods.name: UnwrapFrame
methods.description: Returns the original VideoFrame from a wrapped frame.

methods.name: GetPoolSizeForTesting
methods.description: Returns the current number of frames in the pool for testing.

methods.name: SetCustomFrameAllocator
methods.description: Sets a custom buffer allocator callback.

methods.name: OnFrameReleasedThunk
methods.description: Static helper to post frame release callback to the task runner.

methods.name: OnFrameReleased
methods.description: Handles the release of a frame back into the pool.
